title: Trump announces deal for Russian diesel as Zelensky criticises 'gift to Putin'
description: Ukraine's president said allowing Russia to sell petroleum products would prolong a war that must be ended.

title: NI secretary to ban the Drumcree parade
description: The parade has led to a stand-off between Orangemen and nationalist residents of the Garvaghy Road in Portadown lasting almost two weeks.

title: US unveils sanctions on ICC in move court condemns as 'assault on rule of law'
description: Several member states of the international tribunal, including the UK, say they "strongly disagree" with the sanctions.

title: Polanski vows to stay on as Green leader as he faces criticism after by-election defeat
description: Jewish Greens' leader has said Polanski should resign in the wake of a Zionism row and by-election defeat.

title: King pays Andrew's £1.5m repair bill on Royal Lodge
description: Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor was charged £1.5m in repair and restoration costs after surrendering the lease on the 30-room mansion.

title: JD Vance casts doubt on firing squad execution and says he will not watch it
description: The planned execution of Nidal Hasan by firing squad would be the first military execution in more than 60 years.

title: Widdecombe suspect had 'particular hostility to Reform', court told
description: Kerry is charged with the murder of the 78-year-old former Conservative minister and Reform UK spokeswoman.

title: Lib Dem MP quits frontbench job over Ed Davey's leadership
description: Deputy party leader Daisy Cooper says "the vast majority of our MPs support Ed... and are furious at this distraction."

title: Commentator Katie Zacharia picked as new White House press secretary
description: The conservative commentator currently works as a communications adviser at Trump Media & Technology Group.
